summary.headline: Horary Questions, Folios 49v–55
summary.text: Catalog entries from folios 49v–55 on horary questions about marital return, adversaries, partnership, finding absent people, gifts, friendship, racing charioteers, ambassadors, enslavement, murder, capture, letters, apostasy, and royal death. Astrological judgments invoke the ascendant, bicorporeal signs, benefics, the Moon, Mercury, sign colors, lunar separations and applications in nativities, and Sun–Moon conjunctions.
